title: Strategy Stock Drops as Bitcoin Price Sinks. MSTR Is Doubling Down on Its Bet.
text: Strategy  stock declined after the price of  Bitcoin  tanked over the weekend, souring its cryptocurrency bet.  Strategy revealed in a securities filing Monday that it had snapped up 855 tokens for roughly $87,974 each, or $75.3 million in total, in the preceding seven-day period.  Strategy is no stranger to criticism.
